cross_references.relationship: §1851 requires the conservator to make financial records available to the investigator; §2620 requires annual accountings to the court. The two provisions create overlapping financial oversight — the §2620 accounting is the self-report; the §1851 review is the independent check.

punitive damages companion — willful misappropriation of conservatorship assets may constitute fraud or oppression under §3294, supporting punitive damages in a civil action against the conservator. The §2620 accounting gaps are the evidentiary foundation for the §3294 malice finding.
